# SafeHive Security Solutions

> SafeHive is a leading security installation company in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, specializing in high-definition CCTV camera setup, smart intrusion detection Ajax/GSM alarm systems, and biometric smart door locks.

## Core Navigation & Page Sections

- [Home](https://www.safehive.com.et/#landing) - Introduction to SafeHive security solutions.
- [Services](https://www.safehive.com.et/#services) - Overview of our custom security packages and technologies.
- [CCTV Camera Systems](https://www.safehive.com.et/#cctv) - Detailed information on IP cameras, PTZ cameras, outdoor security, and remote monitoring setup.
- [Alarm Systems](https://www.safehive.com.et/#alarm) - Information on Ajax wireless alarms, GSM burglar alarms, and fire detection systems.
- [Smart Door Locks](https://www.safehive.com.et/#smartdoorlock) - Biometric video locks, Ring Video Doorbells, and office glass door magnetic lock installations.
- [Portfolios & Projects](https://www.safehive.com.et/#portfolio) - Review of our completed security projects in Ethiopia.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://www.safehive.com.et/#faq) - Help and common answers about CCTV, alarms, locks, warranty, and pricing.
- [About Us](https://www.safehive.com.et/#about) - Learn about SafeHive's 17+ years of experience in Ethiopia.
- [Contact Us](https://www.safehive.com.et/#contact) - Reach out for priority consultation or call/WhatsApp.
- [Request a Free Quote](https://www.safehive.com.et/#quote) - Free security survey and system design estimate.
